name: Dornier Wal Seaplane
description: Remains of a Dornier Wal flying boat in Gnejna Bay, a sandy bay on Malta's north-west coast, at 5–6 m: part of the hull with its side floats and a few cockpit parts. After an emergency landing at sea in 1932, the plane was brought to Malta. Also a nice spot for snorkelling and freediving.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites. Position approximate.
